name: Fallow Sanctuary
summary: In the Swamp of Sorrows, Fallow Sanctuary shelters a tribe cut off from the world they knew. The Lost Ones are mutated draenei, driven feral by grief and homesickness.

sections.title: A Refuge Lost to Madness
sections.body:
Among the sunken trees of the Swamp of Sorrows, the Lost Ones have made Fallow Sanctuary their refuge. Separation from their ancestral world and dark energies deformed them.

Sorrow and isolation wore away at the tribe’s sanity. Now they are hostile and feral, attacking outsiders who enter their village.

sections.title: Vanished Leaders
sections.body: Ongeku and Noboru the Cudgel once guided Fallow Sanctuary. Their absence and deaths left the village without its leaders.

faq.answer: Fallow Sanctuary is a settlement in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is home to the Lost Ones, a heavily mutated branch of draenei who crossed through the Dark Portal.

faq.q: Why are the Lost Ones here hostile?
faq.answer: Grief and homesickness have driven the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary mad. Trapped on Azeroth and cut off from everything they knew, they have become feral and attack outsiders.
Ongeku and Noboru the Cudgel once led the Lost Ones at Fallow Sanctuary. Their disappearance and deaths left the tribe without its leaders.

angles.text: As a warlock, you see how dark energies can warp living flesh and shatter a fragile mind in the Lost Ones.
